faq.q: Is the City of Langley the same as the Township of Langley?
faq.a: No — the City of Langley is its own municipality, separate from the Township of Langley, with its own Official Community Plan (adopted November 22, 2021) and its own Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300 (batch-14/langley-city.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How did Langley City detached homes sell in September 2026?
faq.a: The Langley City sub-area recorded 64 detached listings with 8 sold (13%, tied with Willoughby Heights in the Langley set); no City-only median is published — the combined Langley community detached median ($1,345,000) blends in the Township and is not a City figure (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How is this page different from the Langley City page?
faq.a: This slug's feed showed 65 results with an all-detached first page at reading, while the langley-city slug showed 252 results mixing attached and detached product — two feeds for the same municipality. This file researches the city-of-langley-homes-for-sale feed; batch-14/langley-city.md researches the other (batch-14/langley-city.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How many units can a Langley City single-family lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 3284 (adopted June 17, 2024), RS1 and RS2 lots permit 4 units, and 6 units if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.
